traditions.LXX: καὶ τοῖς ἡμίσεσιν υἱοῖς Μαχεὶρ υἱοῖς Μανασσὴ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν .
traditions.VUL: dimídiæ parti filiórum Machir iuxta cognatiónes suas .
traditions.KJV: to the one half of the children of Machir by their families .

32.english_reference: These [ are the countries ] which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab ,

traditions.WLC: אֵ֕לֶּה אֲשֶׁר נִחַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּ עַֽרְב֣וֹת מוֹאָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: Οὗτοι οὕς κατεκληρονόμησεν Μωυσῆς πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου ἐν ἀραβὼθ Μωάβ , ἐν τῷ
traditions.VUL: Hanc possessiónem divísit Móyses in campéstribus Moab
traditions.KJV: These [ are the countries ] which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab ,

traditions.WLC: מֵ עֵ֛בֶר לְ יַרְדֵּ֥ן
traditions.LXX: πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου
traditions.VUL: trans Iordánem
traditions.KJV: on the other side Jordan ,

traditions.WLC: יְרִיח֖וֹ מִזְרָֽחָ ה
traditions.LXX: τοῦ κατὰ Ἰερειχώ ἐπ᾽ ἀνατολῶν .
traditions.VUL: contra Iéricho ad orientálem plagam .
traditions.KJV: by Jericho , eastward .

33.english_reference: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not [ any ] inheritance :

traditions.WLC: וּ לְ שֵׁ֨בֶט֙ הַ לֵּוִ֔י לֹֽא נָתַ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה נַחֲלָ֑ה
traditions.VUL: Tríbui autem Levi non dedit possessiónem :
traditions.KJV: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not [ any ] inheritance :

33.english_reference: the LORD God of Israel [ was ] their inheritance ,

traditions.WLC: יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָתָ֔ ם
traditions.VUL: quóniam Dóminus Deus Israel ipse est posséssio eius ,
traditions.KJV: the LORD God of Israel [ was ] their inheritance ,

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָ הֶֽם
traditions.VUL: ut locútus est illi .
traditions.KJV: as he said unto them .
